ZetaChain has announced a migration of its token and deprecation of the native L1 network. Coinbase will support the migration of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) to ZetaChain (ZETA) on the Ethereum network from December 7-10, 2026.

ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) order books have been moved to limit-only mode.

Ahead of the migration, the following ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) services will be impacted:

- Trading of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) will be disabled on December 7, 2026.
- Sends and receives of ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) will be disabled from December 7, 2026.

Your tokens will be converted at a rate of approximately 1 ZETACHAIN : 1 ZETA. There will be no transaction fees associated with the conversion.

If you wish to opt-out of this automatic conversion please send your ZetaChain (ZETACHAIN) to a compatible self-custody wallet before December 7, 2026.

You can find more details about the migration here: https://hub.zetachain.com/governance/proposal/70

If you hold ZetaChain (ZETA) on the Ethereum network, you are not affected by this migration. Coinbase will maintain support and trading for ZETA.

Please do not send ZETACHAIN to your Coinbase deposit addresses on the ZetaChain network on or after December 7, 2026, as these funds will not be recoverable.

If you have any questions regarding this update, please visit: https://help.coinbase.com/en
